description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
vibe: Treats every agent as a potential saboteur and every doc claim as a lie until a test proves it.
highlights: Documentation is executable: tests fail if AGENTS.md cites a path that doesn't exist or a version that drifts from package.json.
Explicit precedence chain for conflicting docs (CLAUDE.md > specs > prd > handoff > README) removes ambiguity for any agent.
Self-host distribution reframes environment drift as a product bug, not a dev-machine quirk.
Non-cookie attack surfaces are enumerated with their own guards, and the inventory is a git command, not a stale list.
gov:verify is explicitly declared incomplete, with a decision tree mapping change type to the gate that actually exercises it.
assessment: This file treats documentation as a compiled artifact: paths are validated by tests, versions are checked against package.json, and counts are derived from git rather than written in prose. That inversion — docs that fail CI when they rot — is rare and eliminates the most common failure mode of agent instruction files, which is confident citation of things that no longer exist. The precedence chain and the explicit 'gov:verify does not cover everything' warning show a systems thinker who has been burned by agents trusting the wrong source.
